title: Point-balanced arrangements in the real projective plane and the Hirzebruch property
summary: A collection of $m \geq 2$ lines through the origin in $\mathbb{R}^2$ is balanced if the sum of the orthogonal projections onto these lines equals $m/2$ times the identity. A line arrangement in $\mathbb{RP}^2$, endowed with the round metric of curvature $1$, is point-balanced if the tangent lines at every vertex form a balanced collection. A line arrangement $\mathcal{A}$ in $\mathbb{RP}^2$ has the Hirzebruch property if it consists of $3k$ lines and every line contains exactly $k+1$ vertices.
